title: Gaston La Touche
content: Gaston La Touche (French, 1854 – 1913) was a painter who captured the dreamy spirit of gardens, festivals, dancers, fountains, and fireworks.----See more samples and read myprevious post on Gaston La ToucheObituary inAmerican Art News, 1913Book:Gaston la ToucheWikipedia onGaston la ToucheOnline biography atGastonlatouche.com
